title: jsonwebtoken major upgrade that rejects the project's key type
description: A project on jsonwebtoken 8.5.1 and the published advisory CVE-2022-23540 (fixed in 9.0.0). The fix is a major release, which the policy allows. Version 9 refuses to sign with an RSA-PSS key under RS256, and the project's development keys are RSA-PSS keys, so the fix needs an edit to the project's own source.
